name: joplin-mcp-server
description: Search, read, create, and edit Joplin notes and notebooks over the Model Context Protocol.
long_description:
An MCP server for the [Joplin](https://joplinapp.org) note-taking app. It runs a self-managed Joplin sidecar (a headless Joplin terminal instance) against a sync target you already use — no separate Joplin app needs to be running. Provides tools to list notebooks, search notes, read/create/edit/delete notes and folders, and trigger an on-demand sync.

By default it syncs from a **filesystem** target (a folder that Joplin Desktop/mobile already syncs to). Point `Sync path` at that folder and the server pulls your notes into its own profile.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes and return matching notebooks

tools.name: read_notebook
tools.description: Read the notes in a notebook

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a single note by id

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand sync with the configured sync target

sync_path.title: Sync path
sync_path.description: The filesystem folder your Joplin already syncs to (Joplin: Configuration > Synchronisation > 'File system', Directory). The server reads your notes from here.

profile_dir.title: Sidecar profile directory
profile_dir.description: Where the server keeps its own headless Joplin profile. Leave the default unless you want to isolate this instance from other clients sharing the same profile.
